note: a fixed server certificate CertificateConfigurationValidator refuses, a private key file as the certificate: CertificateFactory's CertificateParsingException. The TLS handshake is closed and PortUnificationHandler.exceptionCaught logs a WARN 'SSL or decoder fault' whose throwable is ExceptionHandling.boundedFault's copy of the DecoderException chain (each message after its class name, cut at 256 characters); no CA load is logged, as the validator runs before the factory reads the CA. Netty's close race logs the fault one to three times per handshake: the repeats are folded into one before comparing. Five plain requests first put an HTTP request on each of the five event loops, so the entry carries the port whichever loop the handshake lands on.
